label: inspect-source-preflight-and-cli-auth
command: import urllib.request,json,time,os,subprocess;d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.github.com/repos/gaozhenyang56-blip/wayne-hyperos4/actions/runs?per_page=1&t="+str(time.time())));print(json.dumps([{k:r.get(k) for k in ("id","status","conclusion","head_sha")} for r in d["workflow_runs"]]));print("Configured GitHub credential variable names:",[k for k in os.environ if k in ("GH_TOKEN","GITHUB_TOKEN","GH_HOST")]);subprocess.run(["gh","auth","status"])
action: 检查快速原包预检任务及可用的命令行认证状态。
outcome: 已读取最新 Actions 状态；同时检查是否存在可直接用于正常 GitHub CLI 的已配置凭据。
next_step: 根据真实预检和认证结果选择后续上传路径。
